parsed.post: Discarding 0-10 result 0.8998 because TRAIN_SHARDS included EVAL_SHARD=10, so validation was contaminated. Clean depth-10 best remains 1.0518 on 0-9. Next: halve batch size to 262k to increase optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: On clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' depth 10, halve total batch size to get more optimizer steps in the fixed 5-minute budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest 0.899821 run used train_shards 0-10 while eval_shard was 10, so it is contaminated and should not be treated as a valid improvement.
